lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is the July 15 HARC meeting, where the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave goes to Preliminary Large-Scale public hearing — multiple buildings, multiple lots, and a project big enough to reshape that end of town. That same day, the Board of County Commissioners takes up two Land Use Code amendments covering Natural Medicine Businesses and Nonconforming Lots, both the kind of code language that has real staying power. HARC also reviews alterations to Town Hall and the Parks & Rec building on the 15th, and the Open Space Commission hosts a public-comment-eligible weed pull on the Valley Floor Monday afternoon.

notable.stake: Preliminary public hearings on large multi-building Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific.
BOCC votes on Land Use Code changes for natural medicine businesses and nonconforming lots.
HARC reviews alterations and floor-area addition to two Town-owned landmark buildings.
Public comment accepted at Valley Floor site walk — open to anyone who shows up.
